The '''2GS-91E20 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned space.
